programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Dev discovers that his wife, Reena, has been cheating on him with Ranjit. To teach them a lesson, he decides to blackmail the cheating duo as part of his revenge.

programme.title: Blue Oranges
programme.desc: When a wealthy alcoholic turns up dead, Detective Nilesh investigates the murder by interrogating various suspects that include her former lover, a spoilt brat and the commissioner's brother.

programme.title: Sikka
programme.desc: Vijay and Pranlal, two close friends, decide to marry off their kin in a bid to cement their friendship. Soon, Vijay learns about Pranlal's illegal activities and calls off the wedding.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: Naya Din Nayi Raat
programme.desc: Sushma, a young girl, runs away from home to escape an arranged marriage. On her way, she meets many people, each representing a distinct facet of human nature, who help her in her difficulties.

programme.title: Satya
programme.desc: Durga's brother is killed in a gang war, turning him into a revenge-seeking man with a mission. Now, his ex-girlfriends cop husband is out to get him. Finally, the two team up to nab the real culprit.

programme.title: Viduthalai Part 1
programme.desc: A policeman is conflicted between duty and morality when his department begins a brutal campaign to capture a local activist.

programme.title: Krantiveer
programme.desc: After being disowned by his family, Pratap, a juvenile gambler, ends up in Mumbai where he gets adopted by Laxminath, a landlord. However, when Laxminath is murdered, Pratap vows to avenge him.

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story
programme.desc: Disappointed with his Olympic bronze medal, Prithipal Singh quits hockey and joins a university. However, things get worse for him when he is accused of murdering a student.

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma
programme.desc: Randhir, a straightforward and hardworking man, sets out to avenge the death of his twin brother Ranvir, a criminal, who was murdered by a prison inmate.

programme.title: International Crook
programme.desc: Rajesh, a superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend Shekar in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.

programme.title: Agnivarsha
programme.desc: In a kingdom stricken with drought, two rival priests, Yavakri and Parvasu, try to appease the rain god, Indra. However, their efforts result in adultery, treachery and bloodshed.

programme.title: Craig Charles: UFO Conspiracies
programme.desc: S1 E3 — PentagonCraig and space journalist Sarah Cruddas consider incidents over the US that it has been suggested are being covered up by the Pentagon. They take on the US Navy UAP videos - the 'Tic-Tac' footage, filmed from the USS Nimitz in 2004 off San-Diego, and the 'Go-Fast' and 'Gimbal' videos filmed between 2014 and 2015 off the East Coast in the Atlantic from the USS Theodore Roosevelt.

programme.title: Junk & Disorderly: Henry's Wreck-trospective
programme.desc: S1 E1 — The Weston Park Wreck-TrospectiveCompilation of episodes from the show Junk & Disorderly, which features Henry Cole and other restorers buying, fixing, and selling automotive junk.

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn
programme.desc: S9 E10 — You Bet Your ButtSeth and Ashley have betting on the brain and start the day with a wager that has leaves one of them dressed to the nines. The gambling doesn't stop when a vintage motor city relic makes its way through the doors, and the kids can't decide what it might be worth.

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn
programme.desc: S9 E11 — Homefront HeatAshley is livid when she gets cut out a deal by Les and Seth. Trying to keep the peace - and the business running smoothly - Les separates the siblings, but the battle spills onto the sales floor in a huge way. Les must make a shocking decision between family and business, and the implications could last for a long time to come.

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn
programme.desc: S9 E12 — Strike OutSibling rivalry is at an all-time high between Seth and Ashley, and when she faces down not one but two baseball deals that are clearly outside her comfort zone, Seth cries foul. Les is forced to extreme measures - and volume - to stop their fighting before it drives away customers, but will he be too late.

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: S10 E53 — Wood Green 2David Dickinson and his team head to Wood Green in north London to help people generate cash from their unwanted belongings. Antiques expert Ian Towning doesn't know what to make of a Victorian stereo-viewer and David Ford sees double with a porcelain girl and matching print. Plus, one seller gains a lot of cash for her gold.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: S17 E14 — First Lady of PawnRick grapples over a decision when a WWE Hall of Fame ring hits the store.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: S17 E16 — Titanic PawnA 1906 silver half dollar that belonged to a passenger on the Titanic is brought into the shop.

programme.title: Money for Nothing
programme.desc: S5 E12Sarah Moore and her team of experts get to work on upcycling a pair of mirrors, a lacrosse stick, a wrought-iron stand and a reproduction desk, all found in Beaconsfield.

programme.title: Junk & Disorderly: Henry's Wreck-trospective
programme.desc: S1 E2 — The Stratford Wreck-TrospectiveCompilation of episodes from the show Junk & Disorderly, which features Henry Cole and other restorers buying, fixing, and selling automotive junk.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: S14 E9 — Reign or ShineOn an uncharacteristically wet day in Montebello, King Darrell is on a mission to defend his throne. However, Rene and Casey signal their intentions to undermine his plans. Kenny gets bowled over by his locker, while Lisa manages to rope herself something quite impressive.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: S14 E10 — The King of Montebowl-OBarry shows up to the auction ready to learn, bringing along a present for a certain hustler. Brandi and Bozek get a firm grip on a smaller unit that raises their spirits, while Ivy treats his son to a birthday locker.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: S14 E11 — Here Comes the Calvin-Ry!In Riverside, Lisa dons her cowboy garb and brings her money sock along. Rene sinks his teeth into an unassuming unit, Brandi gets to go on a scavenger hunt, Ivy and his boys get a glimpse of retired life and Darrell just isn't feeling like himself.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: S14 E12 — Zip Tie LiesSan Bernardino is full of surprises, particularly for Rene and Casey, who roll the dice on some sealed totes. Kenny stumbles over some odd-looking car parts, while Lisa shields herself from disaster with an unusually expensive locker.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: S14 E13 — Children of the CornbreadIvy is on the warpath in Lancaster, doing his best to intimidate the other buyers, and he won't be losing any sleep over it. Brandi begrudgingly lets Bozek decide which locker they buy, while Dusty goes up against the King to prove a point.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: S14 E14 — Proxy MoxieBarry utilises a little-known tactic to snatch up a locker, and it ties him up in knots. Brandi shops in the bargain basement but puts on quite a show in the process. Ivy lands a large unit and the tools stack right up.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: S14 E15 — Two for the Price of DustThe big guns come out in Riverside, but Rene isn't having any of it. Darrell presses his luck with a smaller locker and makes a neat profit. Dusty finds that once he gets going, it's hard to stop - so he just keeps re-loading.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: S14 E16 — It's a Safe Time to Get Lit!Lisa heads to Huntington Beach, Darrell spends the right amount of time going through his locker, Kenny rides a recent string of luck right into his unit, while Rene puts his bankroll up against a pair of safes.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: S17 E12 — Capture the PawnRick checks out a rare 1589 manual for war practices and fortifying defences after it is brought into his store.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: S17 E13 — No Pawn for You!A signed script from Seinfeld hits the store, while Chum and Corey go over a barrel for a vintage Donkey Kong arcade machine.

programme.title: Outback Wreckers
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Two Wheel DealsDocumentary following expert wreckers as they hunt for abandoned vehicles and hidden scrap in the Australian Outback.

programme.title: Money for Nothing
programme.desc: S5 E11Jacqui Joseph and her colleagues aim to bring new life to three finds in Altrincham - a four-piece coffee table set, a three-seater sofa and a pair of mid-20th-century deckchairs.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: S7 E10 — Aliens and the Civil WarExperts examine the link between aliens and the Civil War, exploring Abraham Lincoln's strange visions and ghostly images seen at Gettysburg.

programme.title: Craig Charles: UFO Conspiracies
programme.desc: S1 E4 — RendleshamCraig joins forces with space journalist Sarah Cruddas to investigate some of the most perplexing UFO encounters of recent times. Here the duo recall the infamous Rendlesham Forest incident of 1980. The sightings occurred just outside RAF Woodbridge, Suffolk, which was used at the time by the United States Air Force.

programme.title: Storage Wars Canada
programme.desc: S1 E13 — All Out Storage WarTempers flare and prices soar as the buyers confront aggressive guest auctioneer Jeff Schwartz, aka "The Liquidator.

programme.title: Storage Wars Canada

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: Airing from 2005 to 2009 on NBC, the game show series returns to primetime TV with original host Howie Mandel. A contestant must choose from 26 sealed briefcases containing a marker for various amounts of cash -- from one penny to $1 million. The player then eliminates the remaining 25 cases one by one. The chosen ones are opened and the amount of money inside revealed. After several cases are opened, the player is tempted by the Banker to accept an offer of cash in exchange for not continuing the game and possibly winning a larger sum of money.

Family comedy sequel, starring Zachary Gordon and Steve Zahn.

Animated comedy from the director of The Incredibles, with the voices of Patton Oswalt, Ian Holm, Lou Romano and Peter O'Toole.

Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Mufasa: The Lion King

Pixar animated adventure sequel, with the voices of Owen Wilson and Michael Caine.

She then attempts to become the first woman to successfully swim the English Channel. Drama, starring Daisy Ridley and Stephen Graham.

programme.title: Tomorrowland: A World Beyond

Fantasy adventure inspired by the theme park, starring George Clooney, Britt Robertson and Hugh Laurie.

Juan Carlos Fresnadillo's horror sequel to 28 Days Later, with Robert Carlyle, Rose Byrne, Jeremy Renner, Imogen Poots and Idris Elba.

Comedy adventure, starring Melissa McCarthy, Jason Statham and Rose Byrne.

Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Bill Farmer, Jason Marsden and Wallace Shawn.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Scotland's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges for the very first time. Both chefs have decided to make changes to some of their dishes, taking on board criticisms made during the week by the veteran judge.

programme.desc: It is the main course and Chef Chris Wheeler is out to show just how theatrical he can be, his ideas are surprising everyone in the kitchen. No one knows quite what to expect and the veteran chef is hoping it tastes as good as it looks.

programme.desc: It is the dessert course and it is Josh Eggleton who has come up with the most ambitious dessert. He is creating his own self-serve ice cream made from vegetables, he is making everything from scratch including toppings and syrups.

programme.desc: It is the fish course and reigning North West champion Matt Worswick has reason to be confident. However, Kim's confident she has got one up on Matt by baking her own black bread unlike Matt who's taking a shortcut.

programme.desc: Dan Jones explores the history of Cardiff castle over more than 2,000 years and reveals how it became transformed from a strategically important Roman and Norman stronghold to a lavish fairy-tale Victorian home.

programme.title: Britain's Most Historic Towns
programme.desc: Alice tells the story of Norman England by studying the history of Winchester, Britain's most Norman city. Alice attempts to storm a castle in chain mail, investigates the origins of modern surgery and tucks in to an appetising eel pie.

programme.title: Britain's Most Historic Towns
programme.desc: In Norwich, the UK's most Tudor city, Professor Alice Roberts learns about religious intolerance, uncovers the Norwich FC canary's origins and experiences humiliating Tudor justice.

programme.title: Walking Through History
programme.desc: Tony Robinson visits Sherwood Forest and the Peak District as he sets out to discover the real King John.

programme.title: Walking Through History
programme.desc: Tony Robinson hikes 45 miles through the Weald in Kent and the Downs of East Sussex to discover the area's rich and surprising Tudor heritage. At the impressively preserved Penshurst Place, author Philippa Gregory helps Tony relish the fate of the Grand Duke of Buckingham at the hands of the young Henry VIII. Tony finishes in Lewes, where he relives one of the more brutal monastic dissolutions.

programme.title: Digging for Britain
programme.desc: Dr Alice Roberts follows an entire year of British archaeology, joining up the results of digs and investigations the length of the country. The results are astonishing, and sometimes disturbing. Roman finds include the mystery of 97 babies murdered by the Thames, a fabulous Roman coin hoard found in Somerset and a man buried on a layer of dead animals.

programme.title: Digging for Britain
programme.desc: In Norfolk, flint tools unearthed recently push the earliest human occupation back by 200,000 years, to around one million years ago. In Orkney an early farm yields glimpses of our ancestors' earliest religious beliefs and customs.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Ancient Dead
programme.desc: Explorers uncover one of the largest Incan burial sites at Ancon on the Peruvian coast. It may be proof that the Chacoans were a matriarchal society.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Ancient Dead
programme.desc: In 1928, an earthquake shift uncovers a row of painted warriors: seven-foot statues encasing mummies from an ancient civilisation; curious bone arrangements in Winterborne are somehow linked to intermingled ashes from dig sites in Slovenia.

programme.title: Ghost Ships
programme.desc: Marrs Island, Nova Scotia was the site of one of the worst civilian maritime disasters in history, with more than 550 casualties. The team is diving in to search for answers to figure out how this tragic accident came to be.

programme.title: Ghost Ships

programme.title: Walking Through History

programme.title: Weird Britain

programme.title: Digging for Britain

programme.title: Live International Football
programme.desc: S7 E6 — England v Costa Rica 10.06England v Costa Rica (Kick-off 9.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from the friendly at Inter&Co Stadium in Orlando, Florida. programme.title: Live International Football
programme.desc: S7 E6 — England v Costa Rica 10.06England v Costa Rica (Kick-off 9.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from the friendly at Inter&Co Stadium in Orlando, Florida. This is England's final warm-up game before they get their World Cup campaign under way against Croatia in Dallas on 17th June. They will be expecting a morale-boosting victory here against a team that have failed to qualify for the finals for the first time since 2010, and they prevailed 2-0 when the sides last met at Elland Road in 2018 thanks to goals by Marcus Rashford and Danny Welbeck. With analysis from Roy Keane and Ian Wright, commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and reports from Gabriel Clarke.

programme.title: Keane & Vieira - Best of Enemies
programme.desc: The on-field rivalry between midfielders Roy Keane and Patrick Vieira during their time at Manchester United and Arsenal respectively, when they strived for dominance in a golden period for the clubs. In this programme, Gabriel Clarke interviews both men.

The last remaining duo have the opportunity to potentially double the money they have won so far or leave with nothing.

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: S12 E95Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: S17 E9Bradley Walsh hosts as Helen from Somerset, Oscar from Edinburgh, James from London and Leonardo from Eastbourne pit their wits against one of the ruthless experts in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

programme.title: Coronation Street

programme.title: Live International Football
programme.desc: S7 E6 — England v Costa Rica 10.06England v Costa Rica (Kick-off 9.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from the friendly at Inter&Co Stadium in Orlando, Florida. This is England's final warm-up game before they get their World Cup campaign under way against Croatia in Dallas on 17th June. They will be expecting a morale-boosting victory here against a team that have failed to qualify for the finals for the first time since 2010, and they prevailed 2-0 when the sides last met at Elland Road in 2018 thanks to goals by Marcus Rashford and Danny Welbeck. With analysis from Roy Keane and Ian Wright, commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and reports from Gabriel Clarke.

programme.desc: The on-field rivalry between midfielders Roy Keane and Patrick Vieira during their time at Manchester United and Arsenal respectively, when they strived for dominance in a golden period for the clubs.
